notes: Five evaluation/environment seeds, not five independently trained policies.
Wilson intervals describe episode-level binomial uncertainty conditional on these sampled environments.
The five-seed t intervals are approximate descriptive intervals with four degrees of freedom, not robust significance tests.
Roll main success is region_retention_v5 and is distinct from stable holding.
Per-episode reset reseeds the environment; episode duration does not itself invalidate the reset seed pairing.
Initial physical and rendered-depth hashes are checked separately.

limitations: Depth arrays are policy packet float16 values, dimensionless and clipped to [0,1].
Decoded metric deltas multiply encoded deltas by each camera far-near. They compare quantized, clipped depths, not original unquantized renderer frames.
Pixels at 0 or 1 are saturated; their original metric difference cannot be recovered. Equal encoded values may conceal sub-quantization differences.
This diagnostic repeats only a few initial frames and is separate from the formal success-rate sample. It cannot determine the effect of image deviations on success by itself.
Physical hashes cover the existing hook fields; extra captured camera/geometry arrays are compared separately. No claim is made that all possible simulator state has been hashed.
